caption: The drawing depicts a doll with three interchangeable heads displayed above its body. Each head is attached to a loop at the top, suggesting they can be hung or placed onto the body. All three heads are of a baby with blond hair and wear white bonnets trimmed with lace and tied with white ribbons under the chin. The head on the left has closed eyes, the middle head has open eyes and a neutral expression, and the head on the right has open eyes and an unhappy or crying expression. The doll’s body is shown wearing a long white gown with lace at the cuffs and hem, and a lace bib at the chest. The background is plain beige, and the artist's signature, "Eugene Croc," appears in the lower right corner. The image uses soft, natural colors primarily in whites, creams, and pinks, with delicate shading for detail.
title: Doll - "Grace"
